name: excel-mcp
description: Desktop Excel automation on Windows x64 or Apple Silicon macOS (experimental beta)
long_description: Excel MCP Server provides 31 specialized tools with 326 operations on Windows. Apple Silicon macOS support is experimental beta, not full feature parity. Power Query, VBA, Data Model/DAX/OLAP, Tables, PivotTables, charts, slicers, connections, QueryTables, XML Maps, screenshots, advanced visual formatting, and Python result reads are unsupported on Mac. Release builds stamp exact platform capabilities and requirements into separate bundles.
